info.name: Extended OCC Web
info.summary: Run occ commands and SQL queries from a web terminal (admins only)
info.description:
A terminal in the browser for Nextcloud administrators: run occ commands and query the database without shell access to the server. Handy on Nextcloud All-in-One (AIO) and other container setups, where occ otherwise needs `docker exec`.
**occ mode**
- Run any occ command, with tab completion of command names and colored output. - Every command is logged with the user who ran it, in the Nextcloud log and, when enabled, in the admin_audit log.
**SQL mode** (type `sql`)
- Run SQL against the Nextcloud database. Statements separated by `;` run as one batch on one connection, and the batch is rolled back if a statement fails. - Results are shown as tables (up to 1000 rows per query). - Statements that change data or the schema ask for confirmation before the batch runs. Reading or writing files on the database server and starting programs through SQL are blocked. - Ready-made scripts: type `templates`, for example to look up or completely delete a local user. A template only fills the command line; nothing runs until you review it and press Enter.
**Security**
- Only members of the Nextcloud admin group can use the app; every request is checked and CSRF-protected. - Treat access to it like shell access to the server, and run the database as a user without superuser or server file/program rights. See the Security section in the README.
**Limitations**
- Not an interactive terminal: long-running commands (like `files:scan` on a large instance) time out, and commands that ask questions cannot be answered (use `-n`).
info.author: Dillard Blom
